quotedPost.originalText:
Gemini 4 Pro: My Impressions

- It is in Arena under the name Gemini 3.8 Flash.
- It's fast and gives outputs quickly.
- SVG and 3D generation has improved a lot this time, more polished, works well in one shot, and follows what I ask much better.
- We can now generate fully functional games with good visuals. The UI is decent not bad, but not amazing either.
- Its still behind Fable 5.1 and Astra, but the previous checkpoint was bad and they have clearly improved it. They will improve it more, and this time I have faith.

post.originalText:
Gemini 4 Pro Did a Great Job 

This time, Google is serious.

I gave it this prompt: Create code for an SVG of a whale flying through the clouds.

The output is really good much more polished and detailed than the previous checkpoint.

What do you guys think? https://t.co/6ig4zbzyUL
